headline: 25k rows back from the flagged pile: the S2 legacy fold
lede: The PLAICRAFT dataset stage (#1712) shipped the legacy fold: pre-audit takes that were unlabeled only because identity didn't exist yet are attributed to their owner — flagged, reversible, and unable to move any acceptance line. The two data lines still wait for friends' takes, exactly as Jon ruled.

notes.text: Legacy fold (PR #2845): unnamed pre-audit gauntlet takes with native human seats now attribute to the anchor owner under a declared, anchor-proven constant; 4 of 7 fold, the 3 relabeled-model takes stay out per the audit. Flagged rows fell 47,838 -> 22,760; the owner's ledger reads 8 takes / 8 voice sessions.

Line-neutrality is structural, not promised: splits and coverage judge native named humans only, so the fold adds train volume but can never fabricate a second player or a second game. datasetcheck 43/43 with three mutants RED by design; live dataset rebuilt twice to the same digest (696c85888e42).

#1712 stays open and waits on data, not code: friends' takes via /retrogames/join flip the games+holdout lines, and the next plaicraft:dataset run picks them up automatically. One ruling ask (#2844) to Jon on the fold — default keep; revert is one constant.
Rule-4 watch: this was a pipeline PR; the next lane owes game code — flagship gaps and the never-dry rung stay live fallbacks.
